description_zh: 创建一个应用身份凭证（ClientKey）
name: CreateClientKey

parameters.help_en: The name of the attached application access point (AAP)
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的应用接入点名称
parameters.name: aap_name

parameters.help_en:
The passphrase of the ClientKey.

The passphrase must be 8 to 64 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase and lowercase letters, and special characters such as `~!@#$%^&*?_-`. It must contain at least two of these character types
parameters.help_zh:
Client Key加密口令。

8~64位，支持数字、英文大小写、特殊字符`~!@#$%^&*?_-`，且必须包含其中的两种
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the validity period of the ClientKey.

The time is specified in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you do not specify NotAfter, the default value is the creation time of the ClientKey plus 5 years.
If you specify NotAfter, you must also specify NotBefore
parameters.help_zh:
ClientKey的有效期结束时间。

按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

如果您未输入NotAfter，取值默认为ClientKey的创建时间加上5年。
如果您输入了NotAfter，必须输入NotBefore
parameters.name: not_after

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the validity period of the ClientKey.

The time is specified in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you do not specify NotBefore, the default value is the creation time of the ClientKey.
If you specify NotBefore, you must also specify NotAfter
parameters.help_zh:
ClientKey的有效期起始时间。

按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

如果您未输入NotBefore，取值默认为ClientKey的创建时间。
如果您输入了NotBefore，必须输入NotAfter
parameters.name: not_before

KeyAlgorithm.description_en: The algorithm used to encrypt the private key content of the ClientKey. Only RSA_2048 is supported
KeyAlgorithm.description_zh: 加密ClientKey私钥内容的算法。目前仅支持RSA_2048

NotAfter.description_en: The end time of the validity period of the ClientKey

NotBefore.description_en: The start time of the validity period of the ClientKey

PrivateKeyData.description_en: The private key content of the ClientKey

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
